"Food  safety"  shall mean  the responsibility  of  the  consumer not  to  cause  any harm  when  the  food  is  processed,
"Drinking water" shall mean water that is not sufficiently contaminated to cause disease or physical harm to the
body and complies with national standards for bacterial and chemical conditions;
"Food" shall mean any goods imported, manufactured, sold or represented for use as human food, and any item
commonly taken or used in the composition or preparation of food;
